meta.name: Tents & Trees
meta.tag: Match a tent to every tree

hub.tagline: Pitch one tent next to every tree — none touching, row and column counts must match exactly.

all.title: Every tree needs a matching tent
all.desc: Each tree must pair with exactly one tent directly above, below, or beside it — never diagonal, and never sharing a tent with another tree.

all.title: Tap a cell to place a tent — none can touch
all.desc: Tap any empty cell next to a tree to pitch a tent there, tap again to remove it. Tents can never touch another tent, not even diagonally.

all.title: Match every row and column count to win
all.desc: The numbers along the edges show how many tents belong in that row or column. Once every tree is matched and every count lines up, the board is solved — stuck? Hint reveals one cell for you.

game.hintFailToast: Every tent is already right where it should be.
game.winSubtitle: Every tree found its tent — next board unlocked.
